extracted.intended_audience: freelance editors and copyeditors seeking jobs, clients, and networking resources
extracted.subtask_description: A curated list of organizations, directories, job banks, and networking resources editors can use to find freelance and in‑house work. Includes membership boards, searchable member directories, industry job lists, and tips/blog links for marketing.

rubrics_metrics.name: ACES: The Society for Editing
rubrics_metrics.description: ACES is an international members' alliance of editors working in digital media, traditional print media, corporate communications, book publishing, academia, government, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Its job bank connects those in need of publishing services with experienced communication professionals. There's also the ACES Editors for Hire directory.

rubrics_metrics.name: American Association of University Presses—job listings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for jobs in scholarly publishing.

rubrics_metrics.name: American Medical Writers Association
rubrics_metrics.description: This group of medical writers and medical editors provides a member directory and job bank, both accessible by members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Employers and those needing to contract with freelance writers or editors can search the freelance directory and post job openings and project openings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Association of Earth Science Editors
rubrics_metrics.description: This group of freelance earth science editors provides a member directory and a job bank, both accessible only by members.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bay Area Editors' Forum
rubrics_metrics.description: This group of freelance editors and other communication professionals, based in the San Francisco Bay Area of California, provides a public member directory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directory is searchable in three ways: by name or keywords, by job title, and by ZIP code.

rubrics_metrics.name: Board of Editors in the Life Sciences (ELS)
rubrics_metrics.description: Those who join this organization after passing a rigorous 3-hour examination for certification as an editor in the life sciences, indicated by the 'ELS' designation, have access to a members-only e-mail list and to members-only job listings and can be listed in a publicly accessible member directory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certification (ELS) is highlighted as a credential linked to membership benefits and visibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bookjobs.com
rubrics_metrics.description: Use this site, sponsored by the Association of American Publishers, to find jobs in all fields of book publishing anywhere in the United States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listings cover business, design, editorial, marketing, sales, or technology roles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cambridge Academic Editors Network
rubrics_metrics.description: This group of freelance editors and other communication professionals, based in the area of Cambridge, Massachusetts, provides a public member directory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directory is searchable by editor name, by members' skills, and by subject area.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chartered Institute of Editing and Proofreading
rubrics_metrics.description: This group of freelance editors and proofreaders in the United Kingdom provides a searchable public member directory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crafts Publishers' Directory
rubrics_metrics.description: This is a directory of publishers of crafts books and magazines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Council of Science Editors Career Center
rubrics_metrics.description: Listings of freelance and in-house jobs provided by medical and science journals, publishers, and pharmaceutical companies and hosted by the Council of Science Editors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSE serves members in the scientific, scientific publishing, and information science communities by fostering networking, education, discussion, and exchange and by serving as an authoritative resource on current and emerging issues in the communication of scientific information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Directory of CE-L Freelancers (Copyediting-L)
rubrics_metrics.description: Copyediting-L (also known as CE-L), an e-mail discussion list for copyeditors from around the world, provides this public directory listing those of its subscribers who are self-employed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: On the website, click the 'Freelancers' tab, and then use your browser's page-search function to find entries related to specific skills or areas of expertise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial Freelancers Association (EFA)
rubrics_metrics.description: This group of freelance editorial professionals provides a public member directory searchable by member name, skills, specialties, hardware used, software used, location, type of materials handled, and style-guide proficiency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dues-paying members of the association receive emails from the organization's Job List. Publishers, magazines, other businesses, and individual authors needing editorial freelancers can post project opportunities there. The site also includes the EFA Bookshop, which sells booklets that editorial freelancers need for building their skills. The page includes a link for information about how to post project opportunities for freelancers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editors' Association of Canada
rubrics_metrics.description: This group of freelance editorial professionals from Canada provides a public member directory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directory searchable by skills, languages, specialties, media, subject matter, keywords, and location.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editors of Color Database
rubrics_metrics.description: Employers and clients can use database as tool for increasing diversity among their staff members, freelancers, and consultants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As an editor of color, you can join the database. Also note that the website has the Database of Diverse Databases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editors Victoria
rubrics_metrics.description: This group of freelance editors in Victoria, Australia, provides a public member directory.

rubrics_metrics.name: European Medical Writers Association
rubrics_metrics.description: This group of freelance medical writers provides a member directory and job bank.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The organization is open to medical editors too.

rubrics_metrics.name: iHirePublishing
rubrics_metrics.description: Post your résumé and look for publishing jobs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institute of Professional Editors Limited (IPEd)
rubrics_metrics.description: This group of freelance editors in Australia and New Zealand provides a public member directory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directory is searchable by name, product or medium, service, subject area, language other than English, keyword, or company or business name.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigative Reporters and Editors (job listings)
rubrics_metrics.description: The job listings posted by Investigative Reporters and Editors, a nonprofit organization, are for positions such as investigative reporter, news developer, federal politics report, investigative producer, photographer, and data journalist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journalism.co.uk
rubrics_metrics.description: Find writing and editing jobs in publishing, journalism, and advertising.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Most listings are for jobs in the United Kingdom, but a few are for jobs elsewhere in Europe or in India.

rubrics_metrics.name: JournalismJobs
rubrics_metrics.description: Find writing and editing jobs in publishing and public relations and with newspapers, television, radio, magazines, and nonprofits.

rubrics_metrics.name: LinkedIn
rubrics_metrics.description: Use this national networking site to look for jobs in publishing and journalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marketing Tips for Freelancers (EditorMom blog)
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the tips in this post from the blog EditorMom to get your name out there in front of clients.

rubrics_metrics.name: MediaBistro's job list
rubrics_metrics.description: A list of full-time and part-time job opportunities for U.S. media professionals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Northwest Independent Editors Guild
rubrics_metrics.description: This alliance of professional editors in Washington, Oregon, Alaska, and Idaho provides a browsable public member directory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is also a job board, accessible only to dues-paying members of the guild, that lists part-time, full-time, and freelance work opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional Editors Network
rubrics_metrics.description: This group of freelance editorial professionals provides a public, searchable member directory.

rubrics_metrics.name: PublishersGlobal
rubrics_metrics.description: This is a directory of publishers around the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organized by country, subject matter, media, language, city, and publishing-related services.

rubrics_metrics.name: PublishersLunch
rubrics_metrics.description: A daily e-mail newsletter about deals in publishing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publishers Marketplace
rubrics_metrics.description: Listings of job openings in publishing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publishers Weekly
rubrics_metrics.description: Compilations of job listings by the highly respected industry magazine.

rubrics_metrics.name: San Diego Professional Editors Network
rubrics_metrics.description: This group of freelance editorial professionals provides a public member directory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directory is searchable under the categories of editors, writers, and other services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Science Writers in New York
rubrics_metrics.description: This organization for science and medical writers and editors has a public jobs list and offers two e-mail lists, one for members only and one open to both members and nonmembers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Society of English-Native-Speaking Editors
rubrics_metrics.description: This group of English-speaking editors in the Netherlands provides a public member directory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Society of Professional Journalists
rubrics_metrics.description: This group of U.S. journalists provides a jobs directory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directory searchable by city, state, and specialty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Society of Young Publishers
rubrics_metrics.description: This U.K. group of young professionals in publishing and related trades provides a members-only job bank.

rubrics_metrics.name: Society for News Design
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for jobs in journalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Society for Scholarly Publishing—job listings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for jobs and freelance projects in scholarly publishing.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Write Jobs
rubrics_metrics.description: Job listings in journalism, publishing, and medical and technical writing and editing.
